Name: Dinosaur Shirts and Boots
Author: MouseyPounds
Description:
[b]Description:

[color=#ffff00]Dinosaur Shirts and Boots[/color][/b] is a Json Assets mod which adds two shirt styles and two boot styles to complement the DInosaur Hat and Pants from the base game. The shirts can be tailored with Wool + Dinosaur Egg and Wool + Dinosaur Mayo respectively. The boots are both purchaseable from the Adventurer's Guild; they have low base stats but can be custom-tailored to increase those stats just like boots from the base game.


[b]Installation:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url].
[*]Unzip the download and place the included [color=#b6d7a8][code][JA] Dinosaur Shirts [/code][/color]folder into your [color=#b6d7a8][code]Mods[/code][/color] folder.
[/list]

[b]Compatibility:
[/b]
[b][color=#ffff00]Dinosaur Shirts and Boots[/color][/b] requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url] version 1.6 or higher (which means it also requires [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] version 3.0 or higher). It works with version 1.4 of Stardew Valley.

Downloads.Description: Now includes alternate shirt option and two boot options.
